value.rationale: PASS narrowly for the sharp first-step order-invariance obstruction: there is a substantive question whether underrelaxation can preserve positive orthants and monotone coordinate bounds after acceleration. The theorem proves that ordinary post-prediction damping alone cannot repair ANY multi-rate sign split and gives an exact all-damping two-dimensional counterexample; this is more operationally precise than the already-known possibility of later negativity. Does not claim originality of Anderson, least-squares coefficient per se, or generic positivity loss.
